project_type: Python Flask app with static HTML/CSS/JS frontend (SPA-like navigation)
build_system: Docker with gunicorn, deployed on Railway
test_framework: No automated tests - manual verification via Docker build
test_command: python -c "import app" (basic import check since no test suite)
verification_instructions: 1. Run docker build to verify no syntax errors. 2. Verify app.py imports successfully. 3. Check CSS/JS have no syntax errors by reviewing changes.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access, Docker available
contribution_requirements: Do not touch TikTok downloader logic, do not hardcode API keys, do not refactor massively, focus on MAKIMA AI navigation/layout/avatar/chat UI only
key_patterns: SPA navigation via ui.js navigateTo() function, views toggled by display:none/block, body class 'makima-ai-body' added when AI view active, header hidden on AI view, CSS modular (variables.css, base.css, layout.css, components.css, animations.css, drawer.css, responsive.css, makima-ai.css), JS modular (config.js, ui.js, downloader.js, photo.js, effects.js, main.js, makima-ai.js), cache busting via ?v=2.1 query params
directory_structure: app.py (Flask backend), templates/index.html (single HTML template), static/css/ (modular CSS files), static/js/ (modular JS files), static/img/ (images including makima-ai-profile.png)
